thesis: The Atlas ML model continues to indicate strong medium-term performance potential for diversified metals and precious metals stocks. Our long position in Arizona Sonoran Copper (ASCU.TO) is supported by a high ML score and predicted return, reinforcing confidence in this selection. Additionally, a short position has been opened on Tirupati Graphite (TGR.L), driven by its negative ML predicted return and high absolute predicted return, making it a compelling short candidate.
